name: Can I make changes to the design during new home construction?
description: Minor design changes may be possible during construction but can add cost and time; major changes are often difficult and expensive.

mainEntity.name: Can I make changes to the design during new home construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's best to finalize all design decisions before construction begins, minor changes may be possible during the build process, though they often incur additional costs and can extend the project timeline. Significant structural changes are usually difficult and expensive once framing is complete. It's important to communicate any desired changes with your contractor immediately to understand the implications and receive a change order outlining costs and schedule adjustments before work proceeds.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor design changes may be possible during construction but can add cost and time; major changes are often difficult and expensive.
